but none as destructive as when her bedroom caught fire.

What?

A lamp?

Hold up. Let's take it back.
- Surprise! - Surprise!

- Is this a gummy bear lamp? - Yeah, I made it for Carly's birthday.

one of those five-pound gummy bears as the base,
and even a little bear right on the light switch.
I'm not gonna lie, I want this too.
I love this.
Thanks. Hey, do me a favor.

plug it in and turn it on.

it was only a matter of time.
Carly, I'm...
